name: mobilecannon-tow-slope
description: T-009: on the KydlFlat template mountain cliff (20 m rise over a 25 m run, about 39 degrees; the template own slope, nothing built) the Asksvin tows the Mobile Cannon down the face, turns round below and tows it back up onto the top: the cannon never flips (the upright keeper logs every hold) and stays hitched.

steps.name: GunPowdered.goToMountainCliffTop
steps.label: on the cliff top, 15 m from the edge

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinSpawn
steps.label: a tame Asksvin north of the cannon, facing the edge
GameProbe shot: towing down the cliff

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonTowState
steps.label: came down the 20 m cliff (cannon below 59 m), never flipped
steps.regex: towed True, joint True, .*upright True.*flips 0, cannon at \(\d+\.\d, 5[2-8]\.

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinFollowTo
steps.label: turn round below and back up onto the top
GameProbe shot: towing up the cliff

steps.name: GunPowdered.mobileCannonTowState
steps.label: towed back up onto the top (cannon above 70 m), never flipped
steps.regex: towed True, joint True, .*upright True.*flips 0, cannon at \(\d+\.\d, 7[0-5]\.
